source: Short authentic excerpts from the existing 5,011-ad Lecture 2 cohort, supplied redacted Q3 2026 sample; not the Kaggle LinkedIn dataset.
scope: A deliberately selected 24-excerpt catalogue, not evaluation of retrieval over all 5,011 full ads. Search only the quoted fragments, joined with an explicit omission marker. Display titles are anonymized descriptive labels and are not indexed.
annotation_protocol: Assistant-drafted queries, criteria and binary judgments. The original panel was specified before its first model execution. T03 was subsequently revised for teaching realism after inspecting the original results; its revised criterion was specified before scoring the revised query. Every excerpt is assessed for every query. A positive requires the stated evidence in the displayed fragments; absence of evidence means not established in this excerpt, not proof that the full ad is irrelevant. No independent or instructor review has yet occurred. Retain all failures; do not tune on the reported test queries.
revision_note: 2026-10-31: The user replaced T03's task-description query with the job-board query 'data engineer'. The draft criterion operationalizes data-engineering work as pipeline, ETL or ELT development/operation; R01/R02 remain draft positives. All retrieval settings and other queries are unchanged. This is a revised teaching comparison after the original test examples were inspected, not an untouched holdout evaluation.

queries.criterion: The excerpt explicitly describes diagnosing or correcting electrical infrastructure faults. Assembly and testing alone do not satisfy this need.

queries.text: Waren im Laden verkaufen und Regale bewirtschaften
queries.criterion: The excerpt describes operating a retail sales floor, selling goods or keeping retail shelves stocked. Warehouse picking and restaurant service are different tasks.

queries.text: Gäste bedienen und eine Servicestation mit Inkasso führen
queries.criterion: The excerpt explicitly describes hospitality guest service and running a service station with payment collection.

queries.text: Elektrische und mechanische Baugruppen montieren und testen
queries.criterion: The excerpt describes assembly and testing of electrical or mechanical subassemblies, not merely repairing electrical infrastructure.
The excerpt explicitly names both Power BI and DAX as skills. Generic reporting or data pipelines without those stated skills are insufficient.
The excerpt explicitly names SAP and ABAP or ABAP OO as technical knowledge.

For this job-title query, the draft definition of data-engineering work requires evidence of building, developing or operating data pipelines, ETL or ELT for analytics. Querying an existing warehouse without pipeline development is insufficient. An exact job-title match is not required, and anonymized display titles are not indexed.
The excerpt explicitly describes picking goods and putting returns into warehouse storage. Retail shelf management is not enough.

queries.text: Buchhaltung führen und Zahlungen oder Abschlüsse bearbeiten
queries.criterion: The excerpt explicitly describes bookkeeping or accounting together with payments or preparation of financial statements. Restaurant payment collection alone is not bookkeeping.

queries.text: coordinate hiring interviews and find suitable applicants
queries.criterion: The excerpt describes participating in recruitment interviews or filling vacancies as part of the role. Instructions for applying to an unrelated job do not count. This criterion does not require the exact English query words.
The excerpt explicitly names both C# and .NET for application development or algorithm implementation.
The excerpt establishes a nursing role and explicitly excludes night shifts. Night work is a negative; an unspecified shift pattern is not established as satisfying this requirement.
